description.en: EduPluginBench is an executable benchmark for evaluating code-generation models on producing plugins that meet governed ecosystem requirements including least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, and bounded failure. It uses 1,440 mutants and 120 clean references with staged admission levels P0-P4.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Compilation and functional tests do not ensure compliance with security and governance constraints. EduPluginBench provides a staged admission method targeting these gaps, enabling assessment of generated plugins in governed environments, which is critical for safe deployment.
